example.quote: It does not point out where it shall be within the state, or the more exact minutiae respecting it ; but laws will be made by which it will be regulated fully and minutely.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
